{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print('QA orders identified:', qa_mask.sum())

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
print('Refunded orders identified:', refunded_mask.sum())

# Combine filters: keep only completed, non-QA, non-refunded orders
# Also, only include rows where converted == 1 (as per question)
final_mask = (~qa_mask) & (~refunded_mask) & (sales['converted'] == 1)

# Apply filter
filtered_data = sales[final_mask]

# Now compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = filtered_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f'Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted:.2f}')"}
